title: The Fair Work system
log: 2026-10-29T12:22:32Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: No point in the bank covers the Fair Work Act, Commission and Ombudsman; the closest, social, legal and political influences, is a much broader idea about how laws shape business in general.

draft.title: The Fair Work system
card: The Fair Work Act 2009 is the national law that sets the rules for most workplaces in Australia. It covers matters such as pay, conditions, termination of employment and bargaining.
the national workplace tribunal. It sets minimum wages, approves enterprise agreements and settles disputes, such as unfair dismissal claims.
the agency that enforces the law. It gives advice, investigates complaints about underpayment and can take legal action against employers who break the rules.
The two bodies have different jobs. One makes decisions and sets rules, such as wage rates. The other checks that employers follow the law and acts when they do not.
draft.remember: The Act sets the rules. The Commission decides and sets wages. The Ombudsman enforces.

a.q: Which body sets the minimum wages that apply in Australian workplaces?
opts: A single employer's human resources team
a.why: The Fair Work Commission is the tribunal that sets minimum wages. The Fair Work Ombudsman is tempting, but its job is to enforce the law and investigate breaches, not to set wage rates.
a.clue: Which body makes decisions and sets rules, rather than enforcing them?

b.q: Jin works at a bakery in Newcastle and finds she has been paid less than the minimum wage for months. She wants the underpayment investigated and, if needed, taken to court. Which body should she contact?
b.why: The Fair Work Ombudsman enforces the law. It investigates underpayment complaints and can take legal action. The Fair Work Commission is tempting, but it sets wages and settles disputes, and it does not investigate and prosecute breaches.
b.clue: Which body checks that employers follow the law and acts when they do not?
